events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The rider disputes the $6.61 cancellation fee after the driver cancelled, so the fee can only stand through NS-0's branch for driver-side cancellations on a no-show claim [F4][NS-0]. The driver's statement says the rider never appeared and that he waited and called twice, which is the driver's assertion of a passenger no-show [F13][NS-1].

NS-1 requires arrival confirmation, GPS presence at the pickup at that moment, and more than 3 minutes of continuous waiting thereafter [F6][NS-1]. The timeline records a driver tap on "I'm Here" at 18:24:35, and at that moment the GPS places the car 41 m from the pickup point [F6][F1]. The trace shows the driver then remained inside the 200 m radius for 230 s continuously until cancelling at 18:28:25, exceeding the 180 s threshold [F6][F2][NS-1]. All three NS-1 elements therefore hold, so the $6.61 charge is valid and the rider takes no refund [F7][NS-1].

The rider's chat message asking for two more minutes at 18:25 came about 25 seconds after the driver had already confirmed arrival, and the driver stayed and cancelled only at 18:28:25, so the request does not displace the completed waiting period [F10][F6][NS-1]. The record carries no NS-1-style threshold override (no recorded no-show threshold) and no gap in the GPS trace, so the default three-minute rule applies [F2][NS-1].

The trace confirms this is a driver cancellation with a valid no-show claim, so no account flag is triggered; the driver's tap was within the pickup radius, unlike the NS-2 abuse scenario [F6][NS-2]. The rider's profile field shows no upheld no-show disputes, which has no bearing here [F17][NS-1].

Amount: the only money in dispute is the recorded cancellation fee of $6.61, and NS-1 makes it payable, so the amount refundable is $0.00 [F7][NS-1]. A zero refundable amount means no_action under the fee rules [F4][NS-0].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your dispute about the $6.61 cancellation fee has been reviewed and the fee stands. The driver confirmed arrival at your pickup point and stayed there well past the required three-minute wait before cancelling. Your request for two more minutes came in after the driver had already arrived and waited, so it does not cancel out that waiting time. No refund is due, so there is nothing to pay out. Your account is not being flagged. No further action is needed from you.

DRIVER: The $6.61 no-show cancellation fee you applied has been upheld after review of the trip record. The record shows you confirmed arrival at the pickup point and stayed within the pickup area continuously for longer than the required three-minute wait before cancelling, so the no-show conditions were met. No refund will be issued to the rider, and no flag has been placed on your account. No further action is needed from you.
